line_items.description: Black Swift S0 sUAS Platforms: 150 EA @ $18,000 (Period 1), 150 EA @ $18,630 (Period 2), 125 EA @ $19,282 (Period 3), 125 EA @ $19,957 (Period 4), 125 EA @ $20,655 (Period 5)

Mission Days Operational support (30 days @ $2,850 per period), Operational and Testing Support (6 sessions @ $6,000 per period), Operator and Observer Training (1 session @ $6,000 per period), Instructor Training (1 session @ $600 per period), Course Development (Operator/Observer and Instructor courses @ $6,000 each per period)
Travel for Operational Support (Not-to-Exceed $50,000 per ordering period × 5 periods)
Non-Recurring Engineering: Technical Documentation (NTE $66,000 per period), Modeling (NTE $66,000 per period), NHC operational workflow integration (NTE $66,000 per period) × 5 periods
